summary: TPC is a seed potato company in Emmeloord, Netherlands, that breeds its own potato varieties, has seed grown by contract growers and trades conventional and organic seed potatoes. It says it has been developing varieties since 2004 and is led by its founder, Gaby Stet. It is active in, or exports to, more than 50 countries.
products: Contract seed growing with pool options for growers
markets: Africa, North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia
facts: 12 varieties listed on the variety page
New varieties reach the variety list after five years on average
Each new variety is tested at 4 locations worldwide
Head office has 3000 Wp of solar panels
limitations: Ownership, revenue, hectares, tonnes, grower numbers and seed generations are not published on the pages read.
Trial locations, export countries and agents are not named.
Yields and resistances are the company's own statements, and some variety pages contradict themselves.
